title: One source of truth.Every AI tool that mentions you.
excerpt: Lens AI is an embedded knowledge assistant that turns your docs and help content into instant voice and text answers—while surfacing where customers get stuck.
content_html:
LensAI

Stop letting AI guess what's true about you.

ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, your chatbot, your help widget, your sales reps, every one of them is answering questions about your business right now, from whatever version of the truth they happen to have.

Lens AI is what all of them pull from.

The Problem

Right now, nobody controls the answer. And this hurts your customers.

Your knowledge already exists. It's just scattered, stale, and inconsistent by the time anything (human or AI) goes looking for it.

AI Search Visibility

Stop tracking what AI gets wrong about you. Fix it at the source.

Learn more

Product Discovery

Give every customer the same true answer, whether they ask your bot, your docs, or your rep.

Learn more

Website Conversion

Turn your website into a rep that never sleeps and never gets a fact wrong.

Learn more

Internal Enablement

New hires get real answers on day one; not "let me ask around and get back to you."

Learn more

How it works

One source of truth for every AI mention.

Connect your sources, stay current automatically, and show up wherever needed.

Integrations

Connect your tools and show up wherever needed.

Start for free

Pricing

Free to try, affordable to expand.

Simple, transparent pricing that grows with you. Free forever plan.

Support

FAQs

Everything you need to know about the product and billing. Can't find the answer you're looking for? Please chat to our friendly team.

Ready to own every conversation AI has about your business?

Try Lens AI today. It is free to get started. No credit card required.
